name: Biosysen Limited
summary: Legend Strategy International Holdings Group Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the accommodation operation and consultancy business in the People’s Republic of China. It also provides property facilities management, franchise co-operation management, accommodation outsourcing management, and other related services, as well as sells healthcare and beauty products. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong. Legend Strategy International Holdings Group Company Limited is a subsidiary of Hehui International Development Limited.
